title: NASA Water Insight RASI, historical (virtual Icechunk)
description:
A NASA Water Insight dataset ("RASI", historical) published as an Icechunk store with VIRTUAL chunk references into source NetCDF files rather than native Icechunk chunks. Unlike the 2.x bare-`repo`-object layout used by ctrees-agb-icechunk and gmgsi-icechunk, this store uses an older v1-style layout: a top-level `config.yaml` plus `chunks/` and `manifests/` prefixes (confirmed via a bucket listing; there is no `repo` object at this path -- a direct GET for one 404s). CORS confirmed on the bucket.

CORRECTION (browser run, 2026-11): both halves of the uncertainty resolved, and both resolved in the store's favour. `icechunk-js` 0.6.1 opens this layout, and following a virtual reference works: reading one chunk fetches the repository manifest from the store's own bucket and then a byte range out of `s3://nasa-waterinsight/RASI/LSM/HISTORICAL/PERCENTILES/RZSM_percentiles_<yyyymm>.nc`, which answers 206 with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Note that this is a *different host* from the store (`nasa-waterinsight.s3.amazonaws.com`, not `...s3.us-west-2...`), so a deployment that allow-lists hosts has to allow both. The arrays were also inspected: eight variables, each [time(780), percentile(5), lat(152), lon(132)] float32 chunked [1, 5, 152, 132], fill -9999, 1-D float32 `lat`/`lon`. The footprint is not CONUS: lat 23.95..39.05, lon -109.55..-96.45, which is the US southern plains and southwest. bbox corrected to that.

License unknown; declared "proprietary" with a via link.

Expected browser outcome: draws (ramp on the root-zone soil moisture percentile field). One chunk covers the whole grid, so it draws at the item view; one tile read costs 5 percentile levels for the 1 it draws, which is inside the amplification limit of 8.
